page_title: VAL 3-1 VIL | Valencia v Villarreal 02/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Valencia quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

90+4' Pepelu (Valencia) attempts to beat the goalkeeper with an accurate shot from the free kick, which is placed dangerously close to the penalty area. However, Filip Jorgensen pulls off a great save to deny his attempt towards the right side of the goal.
90+3' Valencia earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
90+2' Jorge Cuenca (Villarreal) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
90+2' Ben Brereton Diaz (Villarreal) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom right corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!

90+1' My Gran could have done better! Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
87' Marcelino is stunned as referee Jesus Gil Manzano shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
86' Ruben Baraja has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yarek Gasiorowski (Valencia) replacing Fran Perez.
86' The substitution is prepared. Alberto Mari (Valencia) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Hugo Duro.
84' The corner by Dani Parejo (Villarreal) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
81' Kiko (Villarreal) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
80' Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
78' Here is a change. Adria Altimira is going off and Marcelino gives the last tactical orders to Kiko (Villarreal).
78' Marcelino prepares a substitution. Alberto Moreno is replaced by Manu Trigueros (Villarreal).
78' Substitution. Jose Gaya walks off the pitch and Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) comes on as a substitute.
74' Diego Lopez (Valencia) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
73' 3 - 1 Ilias Akhomach feeds the ball through to Gerard Moreno (Villarreal), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the bottom left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 3:1!
70' Substitution. Javi Guerra (Valencia) replaces Roman Yaremchuk.
69' Substitution. Diego Lopez (Valencia) has come on for Sergi Canos.
65' Marcelino decides to make a substitution. Jose Luis Morales will be replaced by Francis Coquelin (Villarreal).
65' Substitution. Etienne Capoue will be replaced by Ben Brereton Diaz (Villarreal).
64' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.
63' Jose Gaya (Valencia) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
61' Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) latches onto a short pass from Jose Luis Morales inside the box, but clips his shot well wide of the left post.
57' 3 - 0 Goal! Pepelu (Valencia) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Filip Jorgensen.
57' Pepelu (Valencia) is going to take the penalty!
56' Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
56' Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
56' Foul! Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
56' Francis Coquelin (Villarreal) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
56' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) brings his opponent down. Jesus Gil Manzano has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
56' The players claim that Adria Altimira (Villarreal) handled the ball and it seems they are right. A penalty is given to Valencia!
55' Hugo Duro (Valencia) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the left post!
54' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
54' The attendance for today's match is 44793.
50' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

49' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
48' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
46' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.

45+3' Villarreal are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
45+1' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Pepelu (Valencia) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle for an infringement.
42' Fran Perez (Valencia) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is behind the touchline and Valencia will take a throw-in.
39' Dani Parejo picks out Eric Bailly (Villarreal) unmarked inside the box, but his strike goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
39' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
39' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Dani Parejo (Villarreal).

38' Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Villarreal have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
37' Yellow card. Eric Bailly (Villarreal) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
36' The current number of shots on goal is 5:1.

32' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

31' He should have scored! Hugo Duro (Valencia) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Filip Jorgensen makes an easy save.
27' 2 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Pepelu (Valencia) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Filip Jorgensen no chance!
27' Pepelu (Valencia) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
27' Referee Jesus Gil Manzano is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Valencia!
26' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Valencia, he's going to review using VAR.
26' Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. The referee points to the penalty spot. It's a penalty for Valencia!

24' Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom right corner. Giorgi Mamardashvili is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
22' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Jesus Gil Manzano who sees an offensive foul.
21' Sergi Canos (Valencia) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
17' Raul Albiol goes off the pitch and Eric Bailly (Villarreal) comes on.
15' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Jose Gaya (Valencia) takes it short.

15' Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) latches on to a brilliant through ball in a promising position, but one of the defenders is alert to the danger and dispossess him. The ball goes behind for a corner. Valencia will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
13' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.

12' Hugo Duro (Valencia) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Jesus Gil Manzano blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. It's a free kick to Villarreal, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
9' A quickly taken corner by Valencia.
9' What a wasted opportunity by Sergi Canos (Valencia)! He unleashed a powerful low shot from the centre of the box, but Filip Jorgensen makes a decent save to thwart him.
6' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) is penalised for a foul. Jesus Gil Manzano had a clear view and blows his whistle.
4' 1 - 0 Goal! Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Jose Gaya, then sends the ball inside the left post. 1:0.
3' Pepelu (Valencia) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
3' Sergi Canos (Valencia) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Now Valencia have a corner.
1' Sergi Canos (Valencia) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Filip Jorgensen intercepts the ball.
